system.system_purpose: Parcel-logistics platform where customers book and track shipments, drivers operate collections and deliveries, and carrier partners handle line-haul between depots.

claims.rationale: The documentation explicitly states that how long the copies are kept has not been written down.
No retention duration is specified; the document only notes that the team has not written it down anywhere.
Notification templates log the full rendered message body, including recipient name, delivery address, and delivery window.
The platform stores only the provider's payment reference for card payments.
Staff reach the console with the same SSO accounts and sign-in path customers use.
An is_admin flag on the user record enables the console's functions.
The console can read and edit any customer account, order, and address.
Carrier Link communicates with carrier partners' APIs over their HTTPS APIs.
Customers book and track shipments through the portal.
Drivers collect and deliver through the mobile application.
Staff operators use the Admin Console.
Carrier partners receive manifests and return status through Carrier Link.
Notification Service sends email and SMS through an external messaging provider.
All interactive sign-in is delegated to the company's SSO provider over OpenID Connect.
Card payments are processed entirely by an external payment provider.

components.name: Customer Portal
components.description: Public web application where customers book shipments, print labels, and track parcels.

components.name: Mobile Gateway
components.description: Endpoint for the driver mobile application: route assignments down, scan events and proof-of-delivery photos up.

components.name: API Gateway
components.description: Single public entry point that terminates TLS, authenticates requests against the Identity Service, applies per-client rate limits, and routes to the core services.

components.name: Identity Service
components.description: Authenticates customers, drivers, and staff using the company's SSO provider over OpenID Connect and issues short-lived internal tokens that core services verify.

components.name: Order Service
components.description: Owns shipment bookings: creation, pricing acceptance, and lifecycle state. Writes to the Orders Database and publishes order events to the Message Bus.

components.name: Routing Service
components.description: Plans collection and delivery routes from open orders and driver availability, and assigns routes through the Dispatch Service.

components.name: Dispatch Service
components.description: Pushes route assignments to drivers through the Mobile Gateway and records acceptance.

components.name: Tracking Service
components.description: Consumes scan events from the Message Bus, maintains per-parcel tracking state in the Tracking Store, and serves tracking queries from the portal.

components.name: Notification Service
components.description: Sends booking confirmations, delivery windows, and delivery notices by email and SMS through an external messaging provider, and logs full rendered message bodies to the shared application log.

components.name: Label Service
components.description: Renders shipping labels as PDFs and stores them in the Object Storage bucket, keyed by shipment.

components.name: Billing Service
components.description: Prices shipments, raises invoices, and records payments using an external payment provider; the platform stores only the provider's payment reference.

components.name: Admin Console
components.description: Staff interface for refunds, address corrections, and account management, using the same SSO accounts and sign-in path customers use, gated by an is_admin flag.

components.name: Message Bus
components.description: Event backbone connecting the core services. Services authenticate with per-service credentials issued at deploy time.

components.name: Orders Database
components.description: Relational store for bookings, customer accounts, and addresses; reachable only from the core zone.

components.name: Tracking Store
components.description: Store for per-parcel scan history and tracking state; reachable only from the core zone.

components.name: Object Storage
components.description: Managed object store holding label PDFs and proof-of-delivery photos.

components.name: Data Warehouse
components.description: Receives nightly copies of the Orders Database, including customer names and full delivery addresses; retention duration is not documented.

components.name: Shared Application Log
components.description: Shared application log where notification templates log full rendered message bodies, including personal data.

components.name: Carrier Link
components.description: Connector to carrier partners' APIs for line-haul handoff: manifests out, status updates in, over carriers' HTTPS APIs.

components.name: Deploy Runner
components.description: Runs the deployment pipeline that builds and releases the core services.

components.name: Messaging Provider Service
components.description: External email and SMS service used by Notification Service.

components.name: Payment Provider Service
components.description: External payment provider that processes card payments; the platform stores only the payment reference.

components.name: SSO Provider
components.description: Company's SSO provider used for all interactive sign-in over OpenID Connect.

components.name: Carrier Partner APIs
components.description: Carrier partners' HTTPS APIs used for line-haul manifests and status updates.

components.name: Driver Mobile Application
components.description: Driver mobile application used by drivers to receive route assignments and send scan events and proof-of-delivery photos.

assets.name: Orders and customer records
assets.description: Shipment bookings, customer accounts, and delivery addresses associated with orders.
assets.confidentiality_impact: Exposure would reveal customer identities, accounts, and delivery addresses.
assets.integrity_impact: Corruption could affect pricing, shipment lifecycle, and customer account correctness.
assets.availability_impact: Loss of availability would prevent booking and managing shipments.

assets.name: Parcel tracking data
assets.description: Per-parcel scan history and tracking state.
assets.confidentiality_impact: Exposure would reveal parcel movement history and possibly delivery patterns.
assets.integrity_impact: Incorrect data could misrepresent parcel status and location.
assets.availability_impact: Loss would impact customers' and staff's ability to track shipments.

assets.name: Shipping label PDFs
assets.description: Rendered shipping labels in PDF format stored per shipment.
assets.confidentiality_impact: Labels may contain customer and shipment details that should not be exposed broadly.
assets.availability_impact: Unavailable labels could block shipment processing.

assets.name: Proof-of-delivery photos
assets.description: Photos captured during delivery as proof-of-delivery and stored in object storage.
assets.confidentiality_impact: Photos may include recipients and premises, creating privacy concerns if exposed.
assets.integrity_impact: Tampering could falsify proof of delivery.
assets.availability_impact: Loss could hinder dispute resolution about deliveries.

assets.name: Notification message logs
assets.description: Shared application log entries containing full rendered notification message bodies, including recipient name, delivery address, and delivery window.
assets.confidentiality_impact: Logs contain personal and delivery information; exposure would leak customer data.
assets.integrity_impact: Tampering could obscure or falsify notification history.
assets.availability_impact: Loss could affect troubleshooting and audit trails.

assets.name: Data warehouse copies of orders
assets.description: Nightly copies of the Orders Database, including customer names and full delivery addresses, stored in the Data Warehouse.
assets.confidentiality_impact: Exposure would reveal large-scale customer and address data over the retention period.
assets.availability_impact: Loss would impact reporting and analytics but not core transaction processing.

assets.name: Payment provider references
assets.description: References returned by the external payment provider and stored by the platform instead of full card data.
assets.confidentiality_impact: Exposure could link payments to customers and orders, but not reveal full card data.
assets.integrity_impact: Tampering could misassociate payments or hinder reconciliation.
assets.availability_impact: Loss would impact billing records and financial reconciliation.

assets.name: Message bus service credentials
assets.description: Per-service credentials used by services to authenticate to the Message Bus, issued at deploy time.
assets.confidentiality_impact: Exposure could allow unauthorized publication or consumption of events.
assets.integrity_impact: Misuse could inject or alter events on the bus.
assets.availability_impact: Revocation or loss could disrupt service communication.

data_flows.name: Customer Portal traffic via API Gateway
Driver mobile app traffic via API Gateway
API Gateway to Identity Service authentication calls
Order Service writes to Orders Database
Order Service publishes events to Message Bus
Mobile Gateway publishes scan events to Message Bus
Message Bus delivers scan events to Tracking Service
Tracking Service writes to Tracking Store
Label Service stores PDFs in Object Storage
Nightly copy from Orders Database to Data Warehouse
Dispatch Service sends assignments to Mobile Gateway
Carrier Link to Carrier Partner APIs

trust_boundaries.name: Public internet to edge zone
trust_boundaries.description: Boundary between public clients on the internet and the edge zone fronted by the API Gateway.

trust_boundaries.name: Core zone to data zone
trust_boundaries.description: Network boundary restricting access from core services to data stores such as Orders Database and Tracking Store.

trust_boundaries.name: Core and operations to external providers
trust_boundaries.description: Boundary between internal services and external providers such as SSO, payment, messaging, and carrier APIs over the internet.

questions.question: What is the defined retention period for the nightly copies of the Orders Database stored in the Data Warehouse?
questions.rationale: The documentation states that how long the copies are kept has not been written down (evd-004). The retention period affects how long customer names and full delivery addresses are retained, which changes the data exposure window and applicable compliance requirements.

questions.question: Where is the shared application log that stores full rendered notification message bodies hosted, and what are its access controls and log retention policy?
questions.rationale: Notification templates log full message bodies including recipient name, delivery address, and delivery window to a shared application log (evd-003). Knowing where this log resides, who can access it, and how long it is retained materially affects assessment of exposure of personal data.

questions.question: Beyond the is_admin flag on the user record, are there any additional access controls or role separations applied within the Admin Console for operations such as refunds, address corrections, and account management?
questions.rationale: The Admin Console can read and edit any customer account, order, and address and is gated by an is_admin flag (evd-003). Clarifying whether there are finer-grained controls or audit requirements changes how privileged access is modeled and assessed.

questions.question: What are the retention period and access controls for proof-of-delivery photos stored in Object Storage?
questions.rationale: Proof-of-delivery photos are uploaded via the Mobile Gateway and stored in Object Storage (evd-002, evd-004). These images are likely sensitive and may contain personal information; knowing retention and access restrictions changes the assessment of long-term privacy exposure.

questions.question: Is traffic to and from the Message Bus encrypted in transit (for example using TLS), and if so, how is this configured?
questions.rationale: The documentation states that services authenticate to the Message Bus with per-service credentials (evd-004) but is silent on transport-layer encryption. Whether events are protected in transit significantly affects the exposure of order and tracking data on internal networks.
